result.topic_en: Hilbert generalises Maurer's theorem to linear substitutions of an arbitrary algebraic configuration into itself in any number of dimensions, sketches a proof, and notes that it implies, and conversely follows from, the rationality of one-dimensional algebraic configurations admitting continuous transformations into themselves.

items.quote:
Der Satz von Maurer vergl. mein Referat
F. d. M. Bd 20 S. 102 lässt sich verallgemeinern auf die
Transformation eines beliebigen algebr. Bildes in
beliebig vielen Dimensionen indem man sagt:
Alle {+linearen+} Substitutionen eines solchen Gebildes in sich
kann man so darstellen, dass die
Substitutionscoefficienten rationale Funktionen der
Parameter werden.
items.english: Maurer's theorem (compare my review, F. d. M. vol. 20, p. 102) can be generalised to the transformation of an arbitrary algebraic configuration in arbitrarily many dimensions by saying: all linear substitutions of such a configuration into itself can be represented so that the substitution coefficients become rational functions of the parameters.

Gebilde mit continuirlichen Transformationen
[-mit-] {+in+} sich, nothwendig rational sein muss.
items.english: It also follows easily in this way that a one-dimensional algebraic configuration with continuous transformations into itself must necessarily be rational.

items.english: But it can also be shown that, conversely, Maurer's theorem follows from the latter theorem.
